x-summary: One child, spouse or other dependant.
title: Dependent
description: One dependent (child/spouse/other) tied to a person — the follow-up flagged when :family_status's dependentsCount was left as a plain integer rather than a nested list. One PersonRecord per dependent, not an array-valued field on a single record — consistent with how every other repeatable per-person fact in this domain works (:rank_history, :compensation, ...: one record per occurrence, kind + recorded_at + data doing the grouping/ordering, not a nested structure inside one record's data).
